The *Sārammaṇaduka* (Patthana 14.21) is a canonical Abhidhamma text belonging to the *Paṭṭhāna*, the seventh and concluding work of the Pali Abhidhamma Piṭaka. The title identifies it as a dyad (*duka*) concerned with states that possess an object of consciousness (*sārammaṇa*), analyzing conditioned phenomena through the combinatorial matrix of conditional relations.
